notes.title: Celebrating 350,000 Sales! ANNO: Mutationem Launches on PlayStation China
notes.content:
Time flies—it has been 1,041 days since the release of our game. Over this journey, our greatest inspiration and motivation have come from every single one of you who supported us. As an indie game, ANNO: Mutationem has grown from just a concept to what it is today, thanks to your attention, encouragement, and unwavering companionship. Every comment, every piece of feedback, and every recommendation has been a driving force for us to keep moving forward.

To our delight and surprise, as of now, ANNO: Mutationem, our studio's very first game, has achieved an incredible 350,000 sales across all platforms! This milestone reinforces our belief that the true purpose of creating games lies in sharing unique worlds with players like you.
We are deeply grateful to everyone who has supported us, enjoyed ANNO: Mutationem, and interacted with us along the way. Your enthusiasm has brought us achievements far beyond our expectations.

Today, we’re also thrilled to announce that the game launches on the PlayStation China platform! Even better, ANNO: Mutationem now goes into the PS Plus game list. If you’re a PS Plus subscriber, you can download the game for free directly from the store! Grab your controller and dive into this cyberpunk world now! We can’t wait to hear about your adventures!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469021/570794803c156e561157221891988b8e241a5900.png[/img]

notes.title: Thank you from team and looking forward to 3rd year anniversary!
notes.content:
Hi all! Next year we'll be celebrating our 3rd year anniversary! We want to thank everybody who's been supporting us, enjoying Anno and getting in touch, as a first-time studio with their first game, this is more than we could hope for.

For our 3rd year anniversary we'll do our best to update the game with something new! More info about that next year, as well as something new that we're working on!
[b]
As always, if you enjoyed Anno and haven't yet left a review, this would mean a lot to us as it helps us a bunch, so please consider doing so if you haven't yet![/b]

Thank you all for your recent support and encouragement! During this time, we've received a lot of suggestions and comments from players. All of them are really helpful!

After more than a month of struggle, we have improved the game's experience, difficulty balance and added new costumes, while also adding a more complete ending. Players who have already finished the game can also experience the new ending through the cover of the "On the Eve of an Ending".

Meanwhile, due to time constraints, the translation of some languages and English/Japanese voiceover

notes.title: Recent update plan
notes.content:
Dear mutationites! After receiving all kinds of feedback, in the next period, our update will be mainly divided into three parts bug fixes, battle experience optimization, language corrections, and adding some more plot-related content.

1. first, we will continue to fix all kinds of bugs that affect the game experience, including text errors, camera errors, collision errors, etc., which will be a more frequent process. This might be a daily update. 

2. We will also "smoothen" the combat-related experience step by step by optimizing the control of the main character, optimizing the power and special effects of weapons, optimizing the behavior of the enemy, etc., this part of the update will also be an ongoing process. 

3. A part of the quest and side quests will be added to optimize the current plot which is controversial. This part of the update will be released in the near future. This will be focusing on the end game part and won't affect the progress made by players who already finished the game

4. At the same time, we will also occasionally update some other content like clothing. We hope you will enjoy it. 

Finally, thank you very much for your feedback during this time, we still have a lot of work to do but will keep our best to take your feedback into consideration and to make ANNO: Mutationem better. 
We will try our best! Thank you!

The much-anticipated new gaming device Steam Deck has been officially released by Valve.  
<ANNO: Mutationem> is pretty suitable to play on this “handheld-gaming computer” undoubtedly.

We have completed the compatibility to run the game on the Steam Deck, to ensure  <ANNO: Mutationem> runs smoothly under the highest quality in 1280*800 resolution.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Support English, Japanese, Chinese 3 languages voiceover.[/b]

It’s our honor to get so much attention from the players around the world. Hence, beyond the 9 languages subtitles, we have also completed English, Japanese and Chinese voiceovers right before the game launch. Try out the 3 language VO effect by clicking the video below.

[previewyoutube=CQEvoyV8uIc;full][/previewyoutube]

Subtitle Languages:
English / Japanese / Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese / French / Russian / Korean / Portuguese - Brazil / Spanish- Spain 

Voiceover Languages:
English / Japanese / Chinese

notes.title: TGA X Steam Demo Q&A [Black Screen + Loading Issue Now Solved!]
notes.content:
Hi Mutationites! Thank you so much for checking us out during the TGA Steam Festival, and we hope you are enjoying our demo so far!

Below is a list of problems we collected from our players, and will be updated regularly, if you have a question regarding the demo, please please feel free to check this post, and also let us know if you have encountered any other bugs and problems, and we will work on them ASAP!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[b]Q: Some players reported that the black screen appeared after the LOGO page appeared when the game was opened, which caused the problem that the game cannot be played.[/b]

A: We are sorry this happened! There will problems with the Demo that we didn't realize. 
For unexpected black screen + loading issue is now solved!

Anyone still encountering problems, please let us know and we will see what we can do to help! Apologies for the troubles, Cheers![/b]



If there are any other questions, feel free to post in Steam Discussion!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469021/77d6455cc525990d310ca26d9e0e6e3b515fd8cd.jpg[/img]
